A class that has nothing but a `render` method that reads `this.props` does the same thing as a function that takes `props`, with more code around it.

A class that needs to be a class isn't reported. That means a class that:

- reads anything on `this` other than `props` and `context`, such as `this.state`
- has a method or a field other than `render`, `propTypes`, `defaultProps`, `contextTypes`, and `displayName`
- has a constructor that does more than pass its arguments to `super`
- has a `ref` attribute in its JSX
- has a decorator

{/* Generated by src/codegen/lint-rule-docs.ts. Do not edit this section. */}

## Configure

Off by default. To turn it on:

```toml bunfig.toml
[lint.rules]
"react/prefer-stateless-function" = "error" # or "warn"
```

Every option, set to its default:

```toml bunfig.toml
[lint.rules]
"react/prefer-stateless-function" = ["error", {
  ignorePureComponents = false,
}]
```

{/* End of the generated section. */}

## Examples

Reported:

{/* bad */}
```jsx
class Greeting extends React.Component {
  render() {
    return <h1>Hello {this.props.name}</h1>;
  }
}
```

Not reported:

{/* good */}
```jsx
function Greeting(props) {
  return <h1>Hello {props.name}</h1>;
}

class Counter extends React.Component {
  state = { count: 0 };
  render() {
    return <button onClick={() => this.setState({ count: this.state.count + 1 })}>{this.state.count}</button>;
  }
}
```

## Options

| Option | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ignorePureComponents` | `false` | Allow classes that extend `PureComponent`, which skips a render when the props are the same. |

Reported by default:

{/* bad */}
```jsx
class Avatar extends React.PureComponent {
  render() {
    return <img src={this.props.url} alt={this.props.name} />;
  }
}
```

Not reported with `ignorePureComponents: true`:

{/* good {"options": [{"ignorePureComponents": true}]} */}
```jsx
class Avatar extends React.PureComponent {
  render() {
    return <img src={this.props.url} alt={this.props.name} />;
  }
}
```
